item.title: Thoughts on Linux, Neovim, Hyprland, etc.
item.description: I started tinkering with Linux (and the rest of my computer) during the COVID lockdown (like may others, I gather). My first thought was, “I want to be cool” (I was like 13 at the time) so I tried Arch first. Of course Arch Linux installation isn’t the easiest thing (especially for a dumb 7th grader) so of course I bricked my system (probably). Fortunately I had a full backup of my disk and I learned to start with something more manageable first.
